segments.name: U.S. Markets
segments.description: Provides data, analytics and actionable insights to U.S. businesses and consumers, covering credit risk, marketing, fraud, identity verification and personal finance management.
segments.evidence: The U.S. Markets segment provides data, analytics and actionable insights to businesses and consumers.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Provides credit reporting, analytics and risk management services, plus consumer solutions, to businesses and consumers outside the United States.
segments.evidence: The International segment provides services similar to our U.S. Markets segment to businesses in select regions outside the United States.

revenueModel.text: Businesses and consumers pay TransUnion for data, analytics and insights used to manage credit risk, market to customers, verify identities, mitigate fraud and manage personal finances.
revenueModel.evidence: Our solutions enable businesses to manage and measure credit risk, market to new and existing customers, verify consumer identities, and mitigate fraud.

changes.text: In 2024 TransUnion merged its Consumer Interactive operating segment into its U.S. Markets operating segment.
changes.evidence: In 2024, we reorganized our operations to merge our Consumer Interactive operating segment with our U.S. Markets operating segment.

changes.text: In 2024 responsibility for certain international operations moved from the U.S. Markets segment to regions within the International segment.
changes.evidence: In addition, we changed the responsibility for certain international operations previously managed within the U.S. Markets segment to certain regions within the International segment.
